To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Islamic financial system has been more resistant to the global financial crisis than the conventional financial system.
the Islamic finance industry is growing rapidly and is expected to continue to do so in the future, and the Islamic finance industry has been largely immune to the global financial crisis.
the global financial crisis was the result of the failure of the financial system to properly assess and price the risks involved in its operations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: What can Islamic economics contribute to the debate about the causes and lessons of the global financial crisis?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the global financial crisis was caused by both the failure of the regulatory framework and the failure of the conventional financial model to take into account the real needs of the society and the economy.

the crisis was not a failure of the market system per se, rather it was a failure of the regulatory and supervisory system, which was not able to control the market system, and that this failure was due to the adoption of an economic system that is not in line with the principles of the Shari'ah.
Islamic finance is not the solution to the global financial crisis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the crisis is not only an opportunity to reform the financial system but also to restructure the whole economy in a way that is consistent with Islamic values and principles.
Islamic finance is not only a better way to finance but also a better way to manage the risks.
we have shown that there were many causes to the crisis and that the adoption of Islamic finance would not have prevented the crisis, but would have mitigated its effects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the global financial crisis has been an opportunity to rethink the way finance is conducted and to reexamine the role of Islamic finance in a global financial system.

the global financial crisis was not caused by the principles of Islamic banking, rather it was caused by a number of technical and institutional mistakes that are not inherent in the principles of Islamic economics.
Islamic finance has been able to avoid many of the problems of conventional finance, which were at the origin of the crisis.
